sentences.text:
Appellant :- Avalesh @ Monu And 3 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Appellant :- Atul Kumar Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Deepak Yadav,Vandana Rai Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the appellants and learned A.G.A for the State.

This criminal appeal under Section 14-A (1) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (hereinafter referred to as 'SC/ST Act') has been filed against the judgement and order dated 20.05.2022 passed by the Special Judge (SC/ST Act), Aligarh in Session Case No.
1448 of 2022 (State vs. Avalesh alias Moun and others) including the charge sheet dated 02.03.2022 arising out of Case Crime No. 721 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 420, 323, 504, 506, 342, IPC,
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 3(2)(v-a) of SC/ST Act against the appellant nos.
1, 2 and 3 and under Sections 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3(2((v-a) of SC/ST Act against the appellant no. 4, Police Station Delhi Gate, District Aligarh.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for appellants submits that he is not pressing the appeal on merits and the present appeal may be disposed of finally with the direction to the court below that in case appellants Avalesh @ Monu And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92291244/
1 surrender before the court below and apply for bail, their bail application may be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law, including the law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the appeal.
In view of the aforesaid, the instant criminal appeal is finally disposed of with direction to the court below that in case the appellants surrender before the court below within a period of 30 days from today and apply for bail, their bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with settled law.
Till then no coercive measures shall be taken against the appellants.
The instant appeal is disposed of accordingly.
Order Date :- 12.1.2024 Puspendra  Avalesh @ Monu And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92291244/
